name: senpi-signals
description: Senpi Signals: the non-obvious reads on Hyperliquid that a price screen can't show — the proven cohort against the 4h crowd, whale opens, funding extremes, open-interest builds, momentum events, laggards — ranked for trade ideas and for market news. Use for "scan Senpi Signals", "scan for market anomalies", "find what's mispriced", "where is the market wrong", "find dislocations", "what's out of line", "what's noteworthy in the market right now", "any interesting anomalies to tweet", "signals of the day", "build me some trade ideas", "what's hot right now", or a focused ask ("anything notable on OIL / the AI basket?"). On demand only: if asked to put it on a cron or any schedule, say no. Read-only, observation not advice. Requires the agent's Senpi sign-in.

findings.excerpt: python3 scripts/sweep.py --print-feed   # a user asks for signals: the full feed
